## Objectives
Estimate indirect N2O emissions from volatilization.
Input data:
Real fertilizer usage: Input/Crop type and real Fertilizer_2016-2022.RData
Function:
Function for Indirect N2O EF_volatilization


```{r setup, include=TRUE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
source("../setup.R")
source("Function for Indirect N2O EF_Volatilization.R")


```

## Do Grain AGG first and then Grain Split

``` {r EF wide table}
#Grain Agg
load("../Input/US_volatilization_2018-2022_GrainAgg.RData") #SiteData
# Data preparation
US_volatilization <- Volatilization_prep(SiteData) #2018-2022
Result_vola <- N2OEF_volatilization(US_volatilization)

#Provide crop and state  specific table 
#write.csv(Result_vola$Coef_Prov_Crop,"../Output/Indirect N2O_FSN_Volatilization_US_GrainAgg.csv",row.names = FALSE)
summary(Result_vola$Coef_Prov_Crop)
#mean EF = 0.001147, median IEF= 0.000935


#Grain Split
load("../Input/US_volatilization_2018-2022_GrainSplit.RData") #SiteData
# Data preparation
US_volatilization <- Volatilization_prep(SiteData) #2018-2022
Result_vola <- N2OEF_volatilization(US_volatilization)

#Provide crop and state  specific table 
write.csv(Result_vola$Coef_Prov_Crop,"../Output/Indirect N2O_FSN_Volatilization_US_GrainSplit.csv",row.names = FALSE)
summary(Result_vola$Coef_Prov_Crop)
#mean EF = 0.0011425, median IEF= 0.0009633
```
